testcase.name: Scenario: Expand library groups independently in the project tree: tmp/obk-wizard-scenarios/features/application/project-dialog/project-dialog.feature:117:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Expand library groups independently in the project tree ✔ Given the Projects dialog is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the selected project has collapsed Appearance Libraries and Material Libraries groups with entries ✔ When the user selects Appearance Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the appearance library entries are visible beneath their group ✔ When the user selects Material Libraries and presses the Right Arrow key ✔ Then the material library entries are visible beneath their group ✔ And the appearance library entries remain visible ✔ When the user presses the Left Arrow key ✔ Then the material library entries are hidden ✔ And the appearance library entries remain visible ✔ And the active project remains marked in the project list
